source.operator_quote:
y Two questions for you:
  - Q1: approve form C (new 124a row).
  - Q2: confirm b–d still land as one commit (R-IX), which is what the plan already says.

decisions.question: Layer 2 lot link row = form C (profile rows), new Spec 124a row amending Spec 134 §3/§11
decisions.recommendation: The lot link row points at its per-target results through ONE profile key: profile_id = sha256 of the sorted (structure, target, result cell_id) lines of the lot; bylaw_resolution_profiles(profile_id, pointers bytea 53x32 in scope order) holds each distinct pointer set once. Link tables together are bounded by a logic variable resolve_bylaws_storage_budget_mb (Spec 134 §6) checked at POST; the whole-layer bound stays k3_a.

decisions.question: Slices b–d land as one commit ① (R-IX)
decisions.recommendation: Keep R-IX: (b) census/pending/admin/descriptor/red suite, (c) migration, (d) shell/compute/checks land together as one ① commit; nothing registered earlier.
